`graphloc129_e2e_analysis.json` is copied unchanged from the Kaggle dataset
[GraphLoc-129: localization labels and agent runs](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/zzgtylors/graphloc-129-localization-labels-and-agent-runs)
by zzgtylors, released under Apache 2.0. The paper quotes its end-to-end resolved counts, and
`check_paper.py` reads them from this file.
